<p>When we launched <a href="/news/grok-imagine-video-1-5">Imagine Video 1.5</a> last month, it was our best video model yet — better motion, better physics, and better audio. Today it goes further: image and voice references, video from a prompt alone, and native 1080p generation.</p>
<p>Image and voice references start today in the US for SuperGrok Heavy and SuperGrok Plus on <a href="https://grok.com/imagine?referrer=website&amp;campaign=imagine-video-1-5-references-blog">grok.com/imagine</a> and <a href="https://apps.apple.com/app/grok-ai-chat-video/id6670324846">iOS</a>, rolling out to all tiers over the next few days.</p>
<h2 id="text-to-video-and-native-1080p"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#text-to-video-and-native-1080p">Text-to-Video and native 1080p</a></h2>
<p>Describe the shot — no starting image needed. Text-to-video pairs our image generation with image-to-video. Native 1080p is now supported with text-to-video and image-to-video. Text-to-video and native 1080p are generally available on grok.com/imagine, iOS, and <a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.x.grok">Android</a>.</p>

<h2 id="multi-reference"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#multi-reference">Multi-Reference</a></h2>
<p>Each reference image locks one thing in place — a face, a product, a location. Keep a character and swap the scene, keep the scene and swap the character, or hold both and change only the action. Up to seven references per generation.</p>
